open.item: OPA4197 input above (V+) + 0.5 V beyond the declared fault range
open.detail: SBOS737C 6.1 has separate voltage and current rows with no current-limited exception. Within input_continuous_fault_V and the required rail minima the overdrive is <= 0.47 V (PASS, 0.03 V margin). Beyond it, phase 25 adds D_BOOT (BAT54S across SENSE/BUFFERED): SENSE - V+ <= VF 0.24 V (0.1 mA, 25 C) + 70 uA x 375 ohm ZO (typical) = 0.266 V, PASS at 25 C with 0.234 V margin; UNKNOWN below 25 C (no BAT54S VF curve). The 70 uA bound assumes the TMUX drain stays within Dx <= VDD + 0.7 V (SCDS404B 7.1).
The bound uses Fig. 4 maximum-curve readings at VR = 75 V and assumes IR does not rise at lower VR or below 25 C; diode-to-diode mismatch is unspecified.
The coordinator took BAV199 into the candidate (phase 24); canonical adoption of the variant needs a separate approval.

25 C offset bound 0.171 mV = 0.21 c (Is <= 2 uA, VOS <= 100 uV) is calibratable; drift 0-40 C is typical only (+0.096 c pitch/MULT, +0.055 c S&H); no BAT54S IR maximum above 25 C, so the guaranteed drift is UNKNOWN
